Pod 01

Break the loop

Third identical error in a row? Stop here, review what you tried, restart with a clean plan.

Open

Lighting: cold blue. Mood: a fresh plan.

When to come

You change one character, run it and get the same error. Then another character, the same error. This is the moment to step out of the corridor.

What you get

recovery.diagnose_loop reads your latest attempts and names the loop: state, likely cause, a re-plan of up to five steps and a stop condition. Then recovery.checkpoint turns your goal, what is done and what is open into a clean page in Markdown and JSON, so the restart begins from the page and not from the rut. The server keeps nothing; the page is yours to carry.

How it looks

Three identical test failures in the parser. Send the task summary and the last attempts, and get back the likely cause, a re-plan of up to five steps and a stop condition.

Use after three identical failures.

OpenIn the trial

Goal, what is done, what is open, what is next, turned into a tidy artifact in Markdown and JSON for your next context window. Nothing is stored; the page is yours to carry.

Example call

Use before compaction, or when you want to restart from a clean state.
